item.text:
It provides order helpers: totals, percentage discounts, average pricing, and display formatting.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (`undefined`) and throws. Use `i < items.length`.
- Consequently, `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` also fail for every order.
- `averageItemPrice([])` would return `NaN` after the loop fix; empty lists need defined handling.
- `averageItemPrice` divides quantity-inclusive total by line count, so it is not an average per individual unit when `qty > 1`.
- `applyDiscount('toString')` (and other inherited property names) produces `NaN`; only own, valid discount codes should be accepted.
